run_evaluate_crystal_structures: run structure evaluation on predicted crystal structures against experimental references using CSD or pymatgen
run_compute_structure_matches: run structure matching evaluation on all predicted crystal structures in a directory using CSD or pymatgen
run_load_target_structures: run loading of experimental reference structures from CIF files into a dictionary keyed by refcode
run_ccdc_match_settings: run configuration of CCDC PackingSimilarity settings with shell size, hydrogen ignore, and molecular difference options
run_match_structures: run comparison of a single predicted crystal structure against experimental reference structures using CSD or pymatgen
